_meta.title: TriageWiseProdrome — applyOverride cases (req R4 + R2 queue effect)
_meta.validates: TriageService.applyOverride(severity_id, clinician_esi, reason_code, note, queue) -> Result. Persists override, sets clinician_ESI, fires override_applied, repositions queue + fires reprioritized ON REAL MOVEMENT, returns Result.
_meta.nature: INTEGRATION. Seed a scored patient (+ patient_severity) and a pre-populated queue, call applyOverride, assert: Result, clinician_ESI mutation, override row, events, queue movement. Queue must be pre-seeded with fillers so movement (or non-movement) is deterministic.
key_behaviors: old_esi = clinician_ESI if a prior override exists, else system_ESI (guards double-override).
override.system_ESI always records the ORIGINAL system value, even on re-override.
reprioritized fires ONLY when old_position != new_position (real order change).
override_applied fires on EVERY successful override.
SeverityNotFoundError when severity_id missing -> no writes.
Result carries intake_id, severity_score (unchanged - override never touches the score), queue_placement (new position).
reason_code is a StrEnum whose VALUE is a human-readable string (e.g. 'AI driver incorrect') - that value is what serializes into the event details JSONB and the override row, NOT the member name.
Result is a dataclass(intake_id, severity_score, queue_placement) - all int|None. severity_score is int (unchanged by override).
_meta.esi_acuity: Lower ESI number = MORE acute (ESI-1 most). More-acute override moves patient FORWARD; less-acute moves BACKWARD.

cases._why: Patient scored ESI-3 sits behind an ESI-2 filler in the queue. Clinician overrides to ESI-1 (more acute) -> patient moves ahead of the filler. old_position != new_position, so reprioritized fires. Both override_applied and reprioritized logged; clinician_ESI set; Result.queue_placement = new (forward) position.

queue_seed._role: target - starts behind the ESI-2 filler

cases._note: old_esi in both events = system_ESI (no prior override). Patient moves ESI-3 -> ESI-1, crossing the ESI-2 filler.

cases._why: Patient is alone in the queue (or clinician_esi keeps the same ordering slot). updatePatientPosition returns old == new -> reprioritized does NOT fire. override_applied still fires; clinician_ESI still set; Result returned.
cases._note: Only patient in queue -> position can't change -> no reprioritized. note is None (nullable). override_applied still fires.

cases._why: Unknown severity_id -> SeverityNotFoundError; nothing written, no events, no override row.

A patient already overridden once (clinician_ESI = ESI-2) is overridden again to ESI-1. old_esi in the events must be the PRIOR clinician value (ESI-2), NOT system_ESI (ESI-3). Guards the old_esi = clinician-if-present logic.
cases._note: old_esi = ESI-2 (prior clinician), NOT ESI-3 (system). override.system_ESI still records the ORIGINAL system value (ESI-3).

cases._why: Clinician downgrades: system ESI-2, clinician overrides to ESI-3 (less acute). clinician_ESI set, override persisted. If it moves the patient back past a filler, reprioritized fires.

queue_seed._role: filler behind - target downgrades past it

cases._note: Downgrade is valid - clinician can lower acuity. Movement direction is backward; reprioritized still fires on any real change.
